Symphony orchestra · 8:00

Ephemeral Bloom

My role Composition and orchestration

Inspired by Wang Wei’s poem Xin Yi Wu (The Magnolia Dale), the work explores the fleeting life of magnolia blossoms through orchestral colour. Premiered by the Seattle Festival Orchestra in 2024.

Multimedia performance · 2025

I wrote you a letter.

(a letter is what I wrote to you.)

My role Composition

A work for two pianos, typewriter, and multimedia, commissioned by House on Fire. Instrumental writing meets the physical sound and action of typing in a live performance setting.
